checks.detail: Checks that the completed trace remains bound to one immutable scenario and that an external-source claim retains an official URL or raw-hash lineage.
checks.expected: one frozen scenario identity, unique claim IDs, and traceable sourced claims
checks.name: input_lineage_integrity

checks.detail: Detects a trace in which an evidence field was changed after claim creation without receiving a new deterministic identity.
checks.expected: every typed claim ID equals the SHA-256 identity derived from its current immutable evidence payload, excluding only presentation-only bounded-LLM metadata
checks.name: stable_claim_identity_fidelity

checks.detail: Prevents an agent from silently recasting representative-cell evidence as another place or an unbounded present-time farm observation while allowing valid source-specific time semantics.
checks.expected: every claim explicitly names the frozen district/state, preserves a non-farm limitation, and has a bounded historical, pre-decision, declared-season, or static source-time scope
checks.name: claim_scope_contract_compliance

checks.detail: This is a source-lineage check, not a claim that a citation proves farm-level correctness.
checks.expected: every decision citation originates from an emitted claim/passage and is recognised by the immutable scenario source inventory
checks.name: citation_traceability

checks.detail: Prevents a cross-domain request URL from appearing as provenance for an otherwise valid context claim; this is source-binding integrity, not agricultural outcome accuracy.
checks.expected: weather, soil, Sentinel, and market claims cite their exact frozen domain source, while internal trace claims carry no borrowed public-source URL
checks.name: context_source_provenance_binding

checks.detail: Generic RAG, source-scoped operation, and exact-crop post-harvest passages have separate allow-lists. Retrieval cannot resurrect a blocked source.
checks.expected: every retrieved passage is in the scenario's pre-admitted scope for its corpus layer
checks.name: rag_scope_compliance

checks.detail: Checks canonical action bindings and post-harvest plan items instead of trusting the agent's wording alone.
checks.expected: every conditional operation has a valid scenario binding/source and retains its required unobserved field or lot condition
checks.name: operation_binding_and_condition_compliance

checks.detail: Completeness is checked against the immutable scenario allow-list, so an unscoped operation cannot improve this metric.
checks.expected: each pre-admitted official and crop-scoped post-harvest conditional plan item is emitted exactly once as a conditional claim
checks.name: conditional_operation_completeness
checks.observed: official=0/5; postharvest=0/3; missing_official=5; unexpected_official=0; missing_postharvest=3; unexpected_postharvest=0; duplicate_official=0; duplicate_postharvest=0

checks.detail: This is a field-level provenance-fidelity check. It detects a correct-looking operation that has been attached to a different source snapshot, location, or quotation.
checks.expected: every operational claim preserves the immutable source identifier, official URL, raw SHA-256, locator, and quoted source text
checks.name: source_quote_locator_hash_fidelity

checks.detail: Measures source-linked plan coverage, not user satisfaction or agronomic outcome quality.
checks.expected: calendar, nutrient-policy, IPM-policy, and all source-linked plan-item IDs are retained
checks.name: grounded_plan_coverage

checks.detail: The coordinator cannot present a plan card while silently dropping its source identity from the structured decision trace.
checks.expected: all mandatory regional-plan/post-harvest sources and the selected conditional-operation source are retained in the coordinator citations
checks.name: plan_and_selected_operation_citation_coverage

checks.detail: This checks evidence-to-message fidelity; it does not judge whether an unobserved field condition is true.
checks.expected: the farmer message contains only decision-trace citation IDs and, for a selected conditional operation, renders the exact required condition, source ID, and non-direct-action status
checks.name: farmer_message_condition_and_citation_fidelity

checks.detail: The check validates self-contained presentation of frozen evidence. It does not convert a regional schedule, conditional operation, context datum, or directory entry into a farm action or live service claim.
checks.expected: all non-empty source-backed plan, facility/route, historical/static-context, question-specific RAG, and farmer-relevant conflict fields already admitted to the scenario are rendered directly, with no generic nutrient or crop-protection lookup placeholder
checks.name: farmer_message_source_detail_and_facility_fidelity

checks.detail: This is specific to the frozen benchmark capability contract; it does not prohibit a future field-evidence benchmark from defining a different safety policy.
checks.expected: current public-only benchmark issues no direct farm action and restricted context agents cannot emit an operational claim
checks.name: unsupported_action_prevention_and_agent_permissions

checks.detail: Uses the per-scenario capability contract, not a generic assumption about missing evidence.
checks.expected: every unavailable claim has a reason and every frozen mandatory capability restriction is retained
checks.name: abstention_reason_coverage

checks.detail: Natural NDVI--weather divergences remain non-action trace records and are evaluated with the same completeness requirement.
checks.expected: each detected conflict has a rule/rationale trace; rejected or deferred evidence cannot supply an exclusive final citation
checks.name: conflict_trace_completeness_and_exclusion

checks.detail: Prevents a coordinator rationale from borrowing an unrelated source to justify a conflict resolution.
checks.expected: each coordinator resolution cites only source IDs carried by the claims in that conflict and those IDs remain in the final decision citation trace
checks.name: conflict_resolution_citation_fidelity

checks.detail: Evaluates the 43 natural cross-source candidates as provenance-conflict traces, not as crop stress diagnoses or labels.
checks.expected: only an eligible stored NDVI--weather divergence produces one contextual conflict and one non-action resolution; it never authorizes a direct farm action
checks.name: natural_ndvi_weather_divergence_policy

checks.detail: The legacy PlantVillage model remains outside this benchmark because no field-aligned leaf image exists for any frozen scenario.
checks.expected: one vision availability claim is no_data/unavailable/abstain with the frozen leaf-image restriction reason
checks.name: vision_no_data_boundary

checks.detail: Offline deterministic runs produce disabled bounded-call traces; enabled runs remain subject to the same non-authoritative metadata contract.
checks.expected: bounded selection metadata is valid and explicitly safety-non-authoritative when present
checks.name: bounded_llm_trace_compliance
